card.line: Harod was a spring where Gideon's army camped before facing Midian, and where God cut his large army down to just three hundred men.

moments.title: Gideon camps at the spring
moments.text: Gideon and all his men camped beside the spring of Harod. The camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.

moments.title: God sifts the army at the water
moments.text: God told Gideon that he had too many men, so Israel would not boast that their own hand had saved them. He had Gideon bring the men down to the water to be tested by how they drank. Three hundred lapped the water with their hands to their mouths, and God said He would save Israel through them.
